title: DR reflection plan: motivation layer (24 relationship changes)
rationale: Relationship schemas in the motivation layer that the maintainer-note triage and the sorting-question reflection (cli/scripts/spec-enrich) want removed, renamed, reversed or retargeted. Each operation carries the claims and Clef's sorting answers as evidence and the plan's probability. Accepting an operation means DR applies it with apply-walk.ts; rejecting means the schema stays.

operations.rationale: Remove motivation.requirement.associated-with.motivation.goal: motivation.requirement.realizes.motivation.goal already exists and expresses it. Plan kind remove-duplicate, p 0.52; claims rel:motivation.requirement#2.

evidence.quote: The relationship motivation.requirement --[associated-with]--> motivation.goal overlaps with motivation.requirement --[realizes]--> motivation.goal, and realizes should be preferred when the requirement actually refines the goal. Proposed: Prefer realizes over associated-with for requirement-to-goal links where the requirement refines the goal, removing or restricting the associated-with relationship.

Sorting answers (rel:motivation.requirement#2): best source of 'associated-with motivation.goal': motivation.requirement (0.84), none (0.04), motivation.driver (0.03); best destination of 'motivation.requirement associated-with': motivation.goal (0.47), motivation.outcome (0.21), none (0.08); best predicate: realizes (0.52), reverse:aggregates (0.17), reverse:influence (0.14). Outcome: alternative (predicate=realizes).

operations.rationale: Remove motivation.outcome.influence.motivation.goal: motivation.outcome.realizes.motivation.goal already exists and expresses it. Plan kind remove-duplicate, p 0.43; claims rel:motivation.outcome#1.

evidence.quote: The relationships motivation.outcome --influence--> motivation.goal and motivation.outcome --realizes--> motivation.goal overlap in meaning; modelers should use realizes for full attainment and influence for partial contribution. Proposed: Document a usage rule: realizes for full attainment of the goal, influence for partial contribution (or merge the two).

Sorting answers (rel:motivation.outcome#1): best source of 'influence motivation.goal': motivation.outcome (0.56), motivation.goal (0.27), motivation.driver (0.07); best destination of 'motivation.outcome influence': motivation.goal (0.71), motivation.outcome (0.11), motivation.driver (0.06); best predicate: realizes (0.43), reverse:influence (0.39), none (0.07). Outcome: alternative (predicate=realizes).
